about.subtitle: We are a community of professionals from the gaming world who don’t want to be limited to traditional employment.
about.text1: We started our journey in 2015 when we organized a game development incubator, where we trained and supported young developers, helping them to bring their ideas to life. Since then we have grown to become Gdhub - a unique platform that brings together experienced professionals from different areas of game development into dynamic and creative teams.
about.text2: On Gdhub you can find partners to co-develop commercial video games, as well as share knowledge and experience with other members of the community.
about.text3: We work in a gig economy - an economy of temporary and non-permanent work, which gives us flexibility and independence. We value freedom, creativity and the ability to choose interesting projects.
about.title: WHO WE ARE

author.text1: Our platform is actively used by many professionals from various fields - game designers, programmers, artists, animators, etc.
author.text2: Start developing a game without funding for a team
author.text3: Each Author can choose the format of work on our portal: as a part of the Gamelab incubation program or work independently at his own pace
author.title: FOR AUTHORS

feedback.subtitle: We are happy to work long-term with our users!
feedback.text0: Currently I work at OpenMyGame as a Middle GameDesigner. I wanted to participate in the gamelab as a gd and pm to gain experience. Everything planned was a success. Met interesting people. Subsequently, this experience and the very fact of participating in such an event greatly helped in finding my first job as a CEO. I wish new participants good luck and patience.
feedback.text1: My main goals were to gain experience working on the game with a whole team, but after a couple of months it became clear that no one wanted to give up the game, and we continued to polish the demo version. As a result, after almost a year of work, we had a demo version with the most basic functionality, a good starting visual, music and even a full-fledged trailer.
feedback.text2:
I work as a GD (game designer) in a dev company, making games for the mobile market. I came there
		immediately after the lab as a level designer. I still communicate with some team members, and we work
		together with the 3D artist :)
feedback.text3: I wish the following projects on the lab: experienced leads and clearer goals. And also the same passion and interest in the project as our team.
feedback.text4: Thank you so much for this experience. I was able to experience a lot of things live.
feedback.text5: Team - 🔥🔥🔥. Thank you for the opportunity to work with you!)
feedback.text6: I love my team! I would like to continue working together. My wish is to achieve success and move on despite all obstacles)
feedback.text7: No training will give you as many emotions and as much new practice as the GD Hub gave me personally. After all, all members of your team do not owe you anything and are not obligated to do anything. All you have is your idea, your experience in something and your internal energy, which will allow you to lead the team from start to finish and continue to lead it further until your product reaches a real player.
feedback.text8: The team has formed quite well, if this game doesn’t work out and the majority doesn’t run away, then you can try to start the next game from scratch and taking into account the experience gained.
feedback.text9: All is cool! Let's move on ;)
feedback.title: What our users say
